title: TsetlinWiSARD: On-Chip Training of Weightless Neural Networks using Tsetlin Automata on FPGAs
venue: DAC 2026 (63rd ACM/IEEE Design Automation Conference), arXiv preprint
new_feature: Trains WiSARD weightless neural networks with Tsetlin automata: one TA per LUT entry, iterative reward/penalty feedback on misclassification (increment true discriminator, decrement predicted) instead of one-shot memorisation. Processor-free FPGA on-chip training architecture stores TA teams in LUTRAMs with ripple-carry adders and a bitwise LFSR for feedback probability.

Fig. 10 TM vs TsetlinWiSARD accuracy-vs-TA-count plots have no printed numbers and were not extracted (TM points at 6/12/18 clauses etc.). Table 1 confirmed on rendered page 6; hardware metrics attached to dataset_id mnist. Although TsetlinWiSARD is not a Tsetlin machine, it is flagged is_tm=true as a Tsetlin-automata learner. F-CNN accuracy N/A in paper.
